items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: my father used to collect records -- Butterfield and Ma Rainey, Beans and Suzie, and Bessie Smith, and Gene Austin

ctx.x: But now, all during this time, I was still listening to records, you know; as I told you, from an early age -- my father used to collect records -- Butterfield and Ma Rainey, Beans and Suzie, and Bessie Smith, and Gene Austin -- he came to Miami I think in 1926, and had a big turnout there for him, you know?
